name: ImbalancedChen.currentChenPairedPrimeSum_le_four_D12_add_error
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop),
  1 ≤ ↑N →
    1 < ↑N ^ (417 / 5000) →
      ImbalancedChen.currentChenPairedPrimeSum N E ≤
        4 * ↑(ImbalancedChen.D12 N) + 246 * (↑N / (↑N ^ (417 / 5000) - 1)) + 4

name: ImbalancedChen.eventually_currentChenPairedPrimeSum_sub_normalized_error_le_four_D12
type:
∀ (epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < epsilon →
    ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop),
        ImbalancedChen.currentChenPairedPrimeSum N E - epsilon * ImbalancedChen.singularNormalization N ≤
          4 * ↑(ImbalancedChen.D12 N)
